title.en: Ziyarat of the 1st deputy Othman Bin Saeed.
title.rurdu: Naaeb-e-Awwal Janab Usman bin Saeed ki Ziyarat.
title.urdu: نائب اول جناب عثمان بن سعید ؓ کی زیارت۔

desc.en: Allama Majlisi says: in one of the old manuscripts associated to one of the great Shia scholars, I found a Ziyarat of Othman bin Saeed Amri Asadi, which is as follows…
desc.rurdu: Allama Majlisi farmate hai hamare ek aalim ki taaleef (compiled book) ke qadeemi nuskhe mein Janab Abu Muhammad bin Usman bin Saeed Amri Asadi ki ziyarat is tarah naql huwi thi…
desc.urdu: علامہ مجلسی فرماتے ہیں: ہمارے ایک عالم کی تالیف کے قدیمی نسخہ میں جناب ابو محمد بن عثمان بن سعید عمری اسدی کی زیارت یس طرح نقل ہوئی تھی۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ، اَلنَّاصِحُ لِلهِ وَلِرَسُوْلِهٖ وَلْاَوْلِیَائِهٖ، اَلْمُجِدُّ فِیْ خِدْمَۃِ مُلُوْكِ الْخَلَائِقِ، اُمَنَائِ اللهِ وَاَصْفِیَائِهٖ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْبَابُ الْاَعْظَمُ، وَالصِّرَاطُ الْاَقْوَمُ، وَالْوَلِیُّ اَلْاَكْرَمُ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O noble servant, a well-wisher for Allah, and His Prophet, and His friends, one who strived seriously for the service of the rulers of the creations, the trusted ones in the eye of Allah and His chosen servants, Peace be upon you O great doorway, and a firm path, and a kind guardian.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُتَوَّجُ بِالْاَنْوَارِ الْاِمَامِیَّۃِ، اَلْمُتَسَرْبَلُ بِالْجَلَابِیْبِ الْمَهْدِیَّۃِ، اَلْمَخْصُوْصُ بِالْاَسْرَارِ الْاَحْمَدِیَّۃِ، وَالشُّهُبِ الْعَلَوِیَّۃِ، وَالْمَوَالِیْدِ الْفَاطِمِیَّۃِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا قُرَّۃِ الْعُیُوْنِ، وَالسِّرَّ الْمَكْنُوْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا فَرَجَ الْقُلُوْبِ، وَنِهَایَۃَ الْمَطْلُوْبِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O he who is crowned with the lights of Imamate, who is covered with the veil of Mehdawiyya, who was chosen specifically for the Ahmadi secrets of Ahmadiyya, and for the Alavi shining stars, and for the Fatimid sons, Peace be upon you O light for the eyes and the hidden secret, Peace be upon you O relief for the hearts, and the final desire.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا شَمْسَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، وَرُكْنَ الْاَشْیَاعِ الْمُنْقَطِعِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی وَلِیِّ الْاَیْتَامِ، وَعَمِیْدِ الْجَحَاجِحَۃِ الْكِرَامِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَی الْوَسِیْلَۃِ اِلٰی سِرِّ اللهِ فِی الْخَلَائِقِ، وَخَلِیْفَۃِ وَلِیِّ اللهِ الْفَاتِقِ الرَّاتِقِ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O believer’s sun, and the reliable pillar for the disconnected Shias, Peace be upon you O guardian of the orphans, and the authentic one in the eyes of the honourable Masters, Peace be upon you O means toward the divine secret between the people, and the vicegerent of Allah s Guardian, the mender, the solver.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا نَائِبَ قِوَامِ الْاِسْلَامِ، وَبَهَائِ الْاَیَّامِ، وَحُجَّۃِ اللهِ الْمَلِكِ الْعَلَّامِ عَلَی الْخَاصِّ وَالْعَامِّ، اَلْفَارُوْقِ بَیْنَ الْحَلَالِ وَالْحَرَامِ، وَالنُّوْرِ الزَّاهِرِ، وَالْمَجْدِ الْبَاهِرْ فِیْ كُلِّ مَوْقِفٍ وَمَقَامٍ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O deputy of the establisher of Islam, and the brightness of days, and the divine argument, the All-knowing ruler upon the special and common people, the discriminator between the Halal and the Haram, the apparent light, the beautiful glory in every place and position.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَلِیَّ بَقِیَّۃِ الْاَنْبِیَائِ وَ خِیَرَۃِ اِلٰهِ السَّمَائِ، اَلْمَخْتَصِّ بِاَعْلٰی مَرَاتِبِ الْمُلْكِ الْعَظِیْمِ، اَلْمُنْجِیْ مِنْ مَتَالِفِ الْعَطَفِ الْعَمِیْمِ، ذِی اللَّوَائِ الْمَنْصُوْرِ، وَالْعَلَمِ الْمَنْشُوْرِ، وَالْعِلْمِ الْمَسْتُوْرِ، وَالْمَحَجَّۃِ الْعُظْمٰی، وَالْحُجَّۃِ الْكُبْرٰی، سُلَالَۃِ الْمُقِدِّسِیْنَ، وَذُرِْیَّۃِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ، وَابْنِ خَاتَمِ النَّبِیِّیْنَ، وَبَهْجَۃِ الْعَابِدِیْنَ، وَرُكْنِ الْمُوَحِّدِیْنَ، وَ وَارِثِ الْخِیَرَۃِ الطَّاهِرِیْنَ، صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِمْ صَلَاۃً لَا تَنْفَدُ وَاِنْ نَفَدَ الدَّهْرُ، وَلَا تَحُوْلُ وَاِنْ حَالَ الزَّمَنُ وَالْعَصْرُ۔

trans.en: Peace be upon you O deputy of the remainder of Prophets and the chosen one by He who is Worshipped in Heaven, who has been made specifically for the loft positions of the great kingdom, the deliverer from the destructive happenings, the bearer of the victory flag, the waving flag, the hidden knowledge, the lineage of the Messengers, and the son of the seal of Prophets, the joy of the worshippers, the pillar of the monotheists, the inheritor of the bests of the purified ones, May Allah bless them with an blessing that doesn’t end with the end of the world, and doesn’t alter with the change in periods and times.

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنِّیْ اُقَدِّمُ بَیْنَ یَدَیْ سُؤَالِیْ، اَلْاِعْتِرَافِ لَكَ بِالْوَحْدَانِیَّۃِ، وَالْمُحَمَّدٍ بِالنُّبُوَّۃِ، وَلِعَلِیٍّ بِالْاِمَامَۃِ، وَلِذُرِّیَّتِهِمَا بِالْعِصْمَۃِ وَفَرْضِ الطَّاعَۃِ، وَبِهٰذَا الْوَلِیَّ الرَّشِیْدِ، وَالْمَوْلَی السَّدِیْدِ، اَبِیْ مُحَمَّدٍ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ سَعِیْدِ، اَتَوَسَّلَ اِلَی اللهِ بِالشَّفَاعَۃِ اِلَیْهِ، لِیَشْفَعَ اِلٰی شُفَعَائِهٖ، وَاَهْلِ مَوَدَّتِهٖ وَخُلَصَائِهٖ، اَنْ یَسْتَنْقِدُوْنِیْ مِنْ مَكِارِهِ الدُّنْیَا وَالْآخِرَۃِ۔

trans.en: O Allah, before I put forward my demand, I declare Your Oneness, and the Prophet-hood of Mohammad, and the Imamate of Ali, and the Infallibility of their Progeny and the obligation of their obedience. Similarly, through this guided Guardian, steadfast Master, Abi Mohammad Othman bin Saeed, I seek means towards You through his intercession, so that he intercedes for me near the intercessors, and those who possess his love, and have purified themselves for them, to protect me from the mishaps of this world and the hereafter.

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَتَوَسَّلُ اِلَیْكَ بِعَبْدِكَ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعِیْدٍ، وَاُقَدِّمُهٗ بَیْنَ یَدَیْ حَوَائِجِیْ اَنْ تُسَلِّیَ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَشِیْعَتِهٖ وَاَوْلِیَائِهٖ، وَاَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِیَ الْحَوْبَ وَالْخَطَایَا، وَتَسْتُرَ عَلَیَّ الزَّلَلَ وَالسَّیِّئَاتِ، وَتَرْزُقَنِی السَّلَامَۃَ مِنَ الرَّزَایَا۔

trans.en: O Allah, indeed I seek means towards You through Your servant, Othman bin Saeed, and place my demand before You, that (please) bless Mohammad and his holy Progeny and his Shias and friends, and forgiven me from my errors and mistakes, and hide my flaws and wrongdoings, and provide me with safety from calamities.

arabic.text: فَكُنْ لِیْ یَا وَلِیَّ اللهِ شَافِعًا نَافِعًا، وَرُكْنًا مِنِیْعًا دَافِعًا، فَقَدْ اَلْقَیْتُ اِلَیْكَ بِالْاَمَالِ، وَ وَثِقْتُ مِنْكَ بِتَخْفِیْفِ الْاَثْقَالِ، وَقَرَعْتُ بِكَ یَا سَیِّدِیْ بَابَ الْحَاجَۃِ، وَرَجَوْتُ مِنْكَ جَمِیْلَ سِفَارَتِكَ، وَحُصُوْلَ الْفَلَاحِ بِمَقَامِ غِیَاثٍ اَعْتَمِدُ عَلَیْهِ وَاَقْصُدُ اِلَیْهِ، وَاَطْرَحُ نَفْسِیْ بَیْنَ یَدَیْهِ، وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ وَرَحْمَۃُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُۃٗ۔

trans.en: And O Guardian of Allah, be my benefitting intercessor, and a reliable and firm defender; indeed I have come to you with hopes, and am confident that you will decrease the weight of my sins, and I have knocked the door of demands through you, O master, and I hope for the best deputation from you, and I hope to attain prosperity through you towards a just place which I rely upon and intend to reach, and to place my life before him. Peace and divine mercy be upon you.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.en: Then offer the Ziyarat prayer and gift it to him and to all the other deputies who served along with him. May Allah bless each one of them! Then while standing towards his direction, bid farewell to his holiness.
desc.rurdu: Iske baad Namaz-e-Ziyarat padhe aur usey Hazrat Baqiyyatullah Al-Aazam aur unke Naaebeen ko hadiya kare aur phir unki taraf rukh kar ke wida kahe, insha-Allah.
desc.urdu: اس کے بعد نماز زیارت پڑھیں اور اسے حضرت بقیۃ اللہ (عج) اور ان کے نائبین کو ہدیہ کریں اور پھر ان کی طرف رخ کر کے وداع کہیں انشاء اللہ۔
